audience: affiliate managers who run promoter programs in FirstPromoter

useCases.title: Review promoter performance over a date range
useCases.text: List the promoters and open one to see its profile, campaigns and stats. Read the promoter report for a date range.

useCases.title: Track referrals by state and date
useCases.text: List referrals filtered by state, promoter or creation date. Open one referral by its id, or by its email.

useCases.title: Check the payouts that are due now
useCases.text: Read the totals of payouts that are due now, for one campaign or for all. List the payouts with their status.

useCases.title: Approve commissions so they can be paid
useCases.text: List the commissions to find pending ones. Approve them by id. A batch of more than 5 ids runs in the background, so check it by its batch id.

useCases.title: Add a referral to a promoter campaign
useCases.text: Look up the promoter by email. Add a referral to a promoter campaign by email or uid.
